title: The Bell Beneath the Chapel: First Leads
introduction: Tavi is missing. Begin at the village inn and follow the public chapel route.
objective: Find the public notice and the damaged chapel repair record. The crypt remains inaccessible in this chapter.

locations.name: Village Inn
locations.description: Rain taps the inn windows. Mara tends the counter beside a public noticeboard.

locations.name: Ferry Landing
locations.description: A wooden ferry rests beside the landing. Oren checks its mooring.

locations.name: Chapel Path
locations.description: An uphill path runs from the village toward the ruined chapel.

locations.name: Ruined Chapel
locations.description: Daylight falls through the broken roof. Stone steps descend toward a crypt blocked beyond this chapter.

features.name: missing-person notice
features.description: Tavi, the village apprentice, is missing. The notice asks searchers to check the ruined chapel along the chapel path.

features.name: mooring
features.description: A thick rope holds the ferry against the landing.

features.name: waymarker
features.description: A weathered arrow confirms the route named by the public notice.

features.name: broken roof
features.description: Gaps in the roof let the rain through. Stay clear of fallen stones.

features.name: damaged repair record
features.description: A water-spotted repair record is pinned beneath a fallen beam. Its cramped entries need careful searching.

discoveries.title: The chapel route
discoveries.summary: The public notice says Tavi is missing and directs searchers along the chapel path to the ruined chapel.
discoveries.lead: Follow the chapel path to the ruined chapel.

discoveries.title: Unsafe chapel repairs
discoveries.summary: The damaged record assigns chapel repairs to Oren and shows that roof supports were left unfinished and unsafe.
discoveries.lead: Ask Oren about the unfinished chapel repairs.

discoveries.title: Mara's account
discoveries.summary: Mara says Tavi is missing; her ferry lead is a guess, not an observation.
discoveries.lead: Check the public notice and chapel path.

discoveries.title: Oren's admission
discoveries.summary: Oren admits diverting chapel repair funds to buy medicine, leaving the repairs unfinished.
discoveries.lead: Compare the admission with the chapel repair record.

searches.text: You search the notice and record the chapel route in your journal.
You decipher the damaged record and note the unsafe repairs linked to Oren.

facts.statement: Mara thinks Tavi may have gone toward the ferry, but has not seen Tavi there.
Oren does not know what happened to Tavi.
Oren will not give an account of the repairs without further cause.
Oren diverted chapel repair funds to buy medicine, leaving the repairs unfinished.

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.voice: Direct, warm, and worried; speaks as a practical village innkeeper.
knowledgeLimits: Has not seen Tavi at the ferry or crypt.

replies.text: Mara: Tavi is missing. I thought they might have gone toward the ferry, but that is only my guess. Please help me find them.

npcs.name: Oren
npcs.voice: Terse and weathered; speaks like a ferryman used to hard choices.
wants: Keep the medicine purchase private while Tavi is missing.

replies.text: Oren: I do not know what has happened to Tavi. The chapel route is passable from the inn.
Oren: You found the damaged record. I diverted the repair funds to buy medicine, leaving the chapel unsafe.
Oren: I diverted the chapel repair funds to buy medicine, leaving the repairs unfinished. I do not know what happened to Tavi.
Oren: I have already answered. I will not give you an account of the repairs. The public notice and chapel evidence remain yours to examine.
Oren: I will not give you an account of the repairs. Follow what you can establish for yourself.
Oren: The public notice and chapel evidence remain yours to examine.
